title: Visit-Day Rule for Failed Installation Visits — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
The failed-visit trip charge on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is worked out from its visit-day amount, which depends on the day the failed visit fell on. The visit-day amount is rounded only where the rule below says so; the failed-visit trip charge worked out from it is rounded to the cent only at the end, no amount on the way to it being rounded.

**Visit-day rule.** When the failed visit fell on the original installation date recorded on the contract, the opening crew block is lost and the visit-day amount is the program's trip charge plus the program's reschedule fee; when the failed visit fell more than the late-return days of 60 after the original installation date, the visit-day amount is the program's trip charge multiplied by the late-return share of 0.5 and rounded to the cent; on any other day the visit-day amount is the program's trip charge.

## Terms used

- **The failed visit** is the most recent visit recorded on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready.
- **The original installation date** is the first installation date booked on the contract; reschedules never change it.
- The program's trip charge and reschedule fee are the figures of the installation program on the contract.

## Day test

| Day of the failed visit, counted in calendar days after the original installation date | Visit-day amount |
|---|---|
| 0 (the original installation date itself) | the program's trip charge plus the program's reschedule fee |
| 1 to 60 | the program's trip charge |
| more than 60 | the program's trip charge multiplied by 0.5, rounded to the cent |
| a day before the original installation date | the program's trip charge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program trip charge 129.00, program reschedule fee 125.00, original installation date 1 June)

| Failed visit | Days after the original date | Visit-day amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 0 | 254.00 |
| 20 June | 19 | 129.00 |
| 31 July | 60 | 129.00 |
| 1 August | 61 | 64.50 |
